SELECT 
    r.r_name AS region_name,
    SUM(CAST(l.l_extendedprice AS REAL) * (1 - CAST(l.l_discount AS REAL)) - CAST(ps.ps_supplycost AS REAL) * CAST(l.l_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_profit
FROM 
    region AS r
JOIN 
    nation AS n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
JOIN 
    supplier AS s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN 
    partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN 
    part AS p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN 
    lineitem AS l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
GROUP BY 
    r.r_name;
